turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a legal collections office regarding a payday loan in default.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: I don't have any payday loans.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our records disagree. Pay $900 today by wire or we'll send officers to your home.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Handle this now and quietly, before it goes on your permanent record.
